## Candidate Discussion Draft

**Document version 1.0**

This candidate shows how the Rincoin whitepaper would define the network under
the S6/b monetary schedule. It is not adopted consensus and remains subject to
public review, compatible implementation, testing, and voluntary network
adoption.
:::
